cv_sections.summary:
Innovative Machine Learning Engineer with expertise in Computer
Vision, I am dedicated to helping companies leverage AI to create
inclusive and sustainable SaaS solutions, showcased by my latest
work at InstaDeep, which improved sorting efficiency of packages
and ensured Quality Control.
Technical Skills & Tools: Python, Nympy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn,
Pandas, OpenCV, PyTorch, Git, Docker, CI/CD, AWS.
Here are a few examples of my work:
- Reduced crop waste by utilizing machine learning models
(e.g., Random Forest, XGBoost, SVM) to predict ripeness from
hyperspectral images of crops.
- Developed a deep learning model for classifying chest X-ray
images as pneumonia or not, achieving 93% accuracy
- Developed a deep neural network that processes football action
replays and predicts both the action class and associated penalty in
under 2 seconds.
I get excited about opportunities where I apply my skills in a big data
dynamic business environment that values innovative ideas and
strategic thinking. Let's explore potential collaborations! Contact me
at mohamedaziz.cherif@insat.ucar.tn or here on LinkedIn!
